Our Story
From a small table in Irbid.


Ja's Aesthetic began as a table by a window, a heavy book, and a stack of flowers I couldn't throw away. First one locket for a friend. Then another. Then someone asked if I could put her grandmother's handwriting inside one.


Today every piece is still made by hand, in small batches, in Irbid. We press, cut, pour, and finish each one — nothing is mass-produced.
